name: woolly
description: One memory for all your AI apps. Local, private, open source.
long_description: Woolly gives Claude, Cursor, Ollama and your own apps one shared memory that lives on your computer. Memories are plain Markdown files in ~/.woolly that you can read and edit. Newer facts replace older ones, passwords and keys are refused, and nothing ever leaves your computer.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a fact about the user

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: A summary of what Woolly knows about the user

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Move a memory to the trash

tools.name: resolve_conflict
tools.description: Keep one version of a fact that disagrees
